lines.say: Watch Canva's new free AI turn this cardboard sign into a poster.
lines.show: Canva's free AI: cardboard to poster.

lines.say: You've seen it. Most AI pictures spell samosa as samsoa.
Canva Craft's different. It works like a signboard painter.
lines.show: Canva Craft works like a signboard painter.

lines.say: It pencils in the layout and the words first. Then it paints.
lines.show: Layout and words first, then the picture.

lines.say: Fresh samosa, price and all. You can read every word.
And it's open to every Canva user, whether you run a shop or teach tuition.
Here's the catch. Check every letter before you print.
lines.show: The catch: check every letter first.

lines.say: Canva Brush, the editing one, isn't free. You'll need paid Pro.
lines.show: Canva Brush editing is Pro only.

lines.say: Send this to the shop owner who's still writing prices on cardboard. Comment CRAFT.
lines.show: Send this. Comment CRAFT for the prompt.
